pages.title: Cherenkov Quartz
pages.text: A clear crystal with a refractive index so high that charged particles crossing it outrun the local speed of light. Each one leaves a cone of blue light behind it, the optical cousin of a sonic boom, so the stone glows faintly even in a dark chest.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)My first piece came from a cracked chest in an observatory ruin, still glowing. Much later I learned to harvest it from the inside of a Pocket Universe in the Universe Forge, where young cosmic rays are plentiful and every grain of quartz lights up.

Made in $(item)Galton Board$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Deepslate Cherenkov Quartz Ore$(), in veins through the Overworld's deepslate.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Fallout Shelter Stores, Observatory, Observatory Ruin, Survey Benchmark chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Atomic Clock, Block of Cherenkov Quartz, Casimir Plate, Casimir Vacuum Press, Chemical Reactor, Cherenkov Boule, Cherenkov Lattice, Containment Field Glass and more.
